chunks: And on the Day He will call them and say: 'Where are My partners, whom you claimed?'

key_terms.شُرَكَائِيَ: My partners (referring to false deities associated with Allah)

ai.seo_question: What does Allah ask the polytheists on the Day of Judgment regarding their false gods?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the ultimate failure of *shirk* by highlighting that false deities, whether idols or human intermediaries, will be absent and unable to intercede on the Day of Judgment. It serves as a direct refutation of those who claim divine association, emphasizing Allah's absolute sovereignty and the solitude of the believer before their Creator. This moment of divine call (*yunadihim*) marks the transition from worldly claims to eternal reality, where all fabricated hierarchies dissolve.
